data.title: $14.5 Billion Injection: Will U.S. Treasury Trigger 'Round 2' for Bitcoin and XRP?
data.description: The U.S. Treasury Department will enter the active phase of its government debt buyback program on Monday, Sept. 7, 2026. The weekly limit on operations will amount to $14.5 billion, while the maximum volume of Treasury sessions could reach $16.5 billion.Such a large liquidity injection has sparked…
